content.document_title: 2021 ESC Guidelines on cardiac pacing and cardiac resynchronization therapy - Task Force Members
content.note: Report lists declarations of interest as reported to the ESC by the experts during the yearly call for declaration conducted every January covering the previous calendar year. Calls for declaration conducted during development of these guidelines up to and including 2020.

entries.declaration: Direct personal payment from healthcare industry: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, etc. Companies listed: Abbott: CRT/ICD; Boehringer Ingelheim: ICD / CRT; Biotronik: ICD/CRT. Payment from healthcare industry to department/institution for personal services: Medtronic: cardiac rhythm management; Boston Scientific: CRT.
Received institutional research grants from the Novo Nordisk Foundation (declared as other interest relevant to holding an ESC position).
Membership or affiliation in political, advocacy or patients organisations working in the field of cardiology: Member of Danish Heart Foundation.
